name: OCUPHIRE PHARMA INC
summary: OCUPHIRE PHARMA INC is a biopharmaceutical company focused on developing and commercializing novel therapeutics for diseases of the eye. They are headquartered in Melville, New York and their pipeline includes therapies for conditions such as presbyopia and retinal diseases. The company is working on both small molecule and biologic drug candidates to address unmet needs in ophthalmology.
